messages:
luis-docs: Running through the Quickstart today. Found multiple small inconsistencies across snippets: README uses REDWOOD_KEY, Ruby example uses old client signature, and curl line confuses PowerShell users. Opening a tiny PR.

harper-sdk: thanks. which Ruby signature is in the README?

luis-docs: it's `Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ...)` but current SDK expects `Redwood::Client.new(ENV[\"REDWOOD_API_KEY\"])`. New users copy paste and get NoMethodError.

nora-devex: can you paste the proposed Ruby + a PowerShell-safe curl here? I'll add to the onboarding notes once merged.

luis-docs: sure. Ruby snippet: ```ruby
# Ruby (gem v1.4+)
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
puts client.generate(prompt: 'Hi').text
```

PowerShell curl variant: ```pwsh
# PowerShell
curl -Method POST -Uri 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate' -Headers @{ 'Authorization' = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" } -Body (ConvertTo-Json @{ prompt = 'Hi' })
```

matt-support: sweet. also flagging that the Rust sample in examples/ uses an old builder API; I'll open a quick patch to align it to rust-sdk v0.8.0.

harper-sdk: great catch. while editing, add a one-liner near the top: "Note: SDKs implement retries/backoff; curl examples are one-shot." We've seen customers assume parity and then open tickets.

nora-devex: also suggest adding copy buttons to code blocks and a tiny runtime selector so folks pick Node/Ruby/Rust snippets explicitly. I'll file a docs-ui ticket.

luis-docs: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/923 with the env var rename, Ruby/Rust snippet updates, and the PowerShell curl example. PR description links a docs-ui follow-up (#449) for copy buttons.

deploy-bot: docs site rebuild started (job 10021). ETA ~ 6m.

matt-support: once live, I'll update the onboarding checklist and close the related support issues. Thanks for catching this early.

harper-sdk: I'll add a note to the SDK changelog reminding maintainers to bump quickstart snippets when we change constructors.

luis-docs: thanks team, closing after merge :thumbsup:
